channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jose Alvarado | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jose Alvarado from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Leon Rose on Jose Alvarado
item.description:
Leon Rose on Knicks re-signing Jose Alvarado:

“Jose brought a toughness, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to winning from the moment he returned to his home in New York City. We're ecstatic to keep Jose home.”

Leon Rose on Jose Alvarado, Jul 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Williams on Jose Alvarado
item.description:
Suns big Mark Williams on one-game suspension for dust up with Jose Alvarado in win over Pelicans:

“I don't know what I'm supposed to do in that situation. He grabbed me, pushed me. I don't think what I got is just. I'll appeal it, but it's over, we're past it.”

Mark Williams on Jose Alvarado, Dec 31, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Jose Alvarado
item.description:
Jose Alvarado’s absence over the last three due to an oblique strain has also drained some of the juice out of the team.

“The resiliency is at a high level, but our margin for error is small without (Ingram) and without (Alvarado),”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Jose Alvarado, Apr 2, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Brandon Ingram on Jose Alvarado
item.description:
Christian Clark:Brandon Ingram on Jose Alvarado reportedly agreeing to a multiyear deal with the Pelicans:

“It’s beautiful. I’m going to stop putting my card down on stuff now.”

Brandon Ingram on Jose Alvarado, Mar 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.
